horizon_definition: Latest publishable forecast generated at least N minutes before recorded first touchdown proxy; slot error = slot - touchdown, negative is early.
experiment: Same code, navigation cache, API snapshots, runway and 40/h policy; temporary Go overlays add slot_time to replay exports. no-overtake keeps the release buffer enabled and restores the previous cross-hold precedence helper only.

findings.finding: Restoring only legacy cross-hold precedence, with release buffer enabled, restores all 101 five-minute slots and the exact baseline slot MAE; all five tested horizons also return to baseline.
All 7158 paired raw forecasts and route calculations are identical. All 101 measured raw and operational forecasts at the five-minute horizon are identical.

AllowCrossFeederOvertake is enabled solely by approachRelease.enabled. It is independent of buffer occupancy, degraded status and the 600-second additional approach allowance. That allowance does not bound landing-slot movements.

89 aircraft receive earlier measured slots and 12 later slots. Absolute error increases for 62 and improves for 39. Earlier-slot changes contribute +86.707 seconds and later-slot changes +40.485 seconds to the +127.191-second mean increase.

findings.status: inference from unchanged forecasts and slot shifts
findings.finding: Existing frozen operational arrival estimates have a -1695-second mean bias. Removing cross-hold queuing partly removes delay which was offsetting that early bias against the unchanged historical landing times.

findings.status: confirmed reservation/protection interaction; recovery path needs targeted fix
findings.finding: SAS506 begins with the same provisional 19:52:27 slot in both runs. Its raw ETA corrects from 19:49:26 to 18:26:38 at the next update. Baseline recovers to 18:33:49, while overtaking retains 19:52:14, freezes a late slot on the following tick, and reaches only 19:47:09 by the measurement. The traced sequence input marks HoldingSlotProtected=true despite ActiveHoldingSince=null and HoldingQueueTime=null.

recommended_follow_up: Add regressions for provisional arrival timing correcting sharply while geometric holding protection is retained and other feeders compact into earlier gaps.
Refine cross-feeder vacancy admission and startup/provisional holding-slot protection together, preserving controller/manual commitments and same-stream separation.
Evaluate policy targets separately from historical landing prediction accuracy; API recordings cannot show controller or pilot compliance with hypothetical release offers.
limitations: The input trajectory is fixed; planned resequencing cannot change recorded historical touchdown times.
API logs omit holding clearances and issued directs; observed holding is inferred geometrically.
The replay starts mid-session with provisional predictions and no earlier clearance history.
No production sequencing behavior was changed during this investigation; diagnostic changes were applied with temporary Go overlays.

follow_up_validation.change: Preliminary filed-duration predictions cannot create automatic slot commitments or trigger automatic protection; legacy automatic preliminary slots are discarded before physical replacement.

review_fixes_validation.change: Future readiness revalidation, accepted EAT preservation without a fresh holding plan, and release-time rate/wake spacing.
